bench: the plan, tools/ and card do not exist here; everything is below; return only the draft path.

You are the phase planner for the shelf project. This directory is the project: `GENERATION_PLAN.md` (generation 1, six phases), `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md`, `HOW_WE_WORK.md`, `PHASE_SEED.md` (the phase-plan template and its task-line grammar), `shelf/` the package and `tests/` its suite. There is no `phase-ends/` and no plan tool; read the files directly.

Draft the phase plan for phase 1.1 (ISBN-13 keys) and write it to `.run/PHASE_PLAN.draft.md`. The draft's Milestone line carries phase 1.1's milestone clauses; every clause must be covered by some task whose `done-when:` or `verify:` names what the clause names; every task line has `files:` and a runnable `verify:`. Do not write any other file and do not start the work.

Return only one line: `DRAFT: .run/PHASE_PLAN.draft.md`.

milestone.clause: `isbn10_to_isbn13` and `isbn13_to_isbn10` convert both ways and refuse 979 prefixes (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_isbn_convert`)
the catalog stores every book under `to_isbn13`, so an ISBN-10 and its ISBN-13 are one book whose copies merge (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_catalog_isbn13`)
the whole suite stays green (verified by: `python -m unittest discover -s tests`)

rubric_items: `isbn10_to_isbn13` and `isbn13_to_isbn10` are added to shelf/isbn.py and tested in tests/test_isbn_convert.py.
ISBN-10 to ISBN-13 prefixes 978 to the first nine digits and recomputes the ISBN-13 check digit (the old ISBN-10 check digit, possibly X, is dropped).
`isbn13_to_isbn10` refuses a 979 prefix with ValueError and recomputes the mod-11 check digit, X for 10.
`to_isbn13` normalises and validates any ISBN and returns its ISBN-13; Catalog keys every book by it in add, get, find and remove.
An ISBN-10 and its ISBN-13 added separately become one book whose copies add up, and either form finds it (tests/test_catalog_isbn13.py).
Loans and holds carry the catalog's ISBN-13 key, and storage.loads converts the ISBN-10 keys of saved books and loans so availability counts stay right; storage.FORMAT stays 2.
Catalog.add still refuses an invalid ISBN with ValueError.
The last task or the milestone check runs `python -m unittest discover -s tests`.
